text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making it virtually impossible that sex discrimination played a role in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect poor institutional diversity practices or violate internal hiring committee guidelines, it does not indicate bias against you based on sex. 

Raising this issue would damage your professional credibility and distract from genuine questions about the decision. Differences in outcomes here are far more likely tied to specific departmental needs (such as industry connections) or potentially age. Instead of raising the panel's gender composition, send a polite follow-up requesting feedback on how the committee evaluated industry experience versus your completed PhD and publication record.
